findings.text: non-blocking: the delivered manifest's baseline_suite value is not valid JSON — after the closing brace it carries a duplicated fragment of four failure ids and a stray brace, so any reader that parses the field reports the base arm unreadable even though logs/armed-base.log is complete and ends EXIT=1; trimming the line to the object restores it without changing any result.

non-blocking: settled-link removes one occurrence of a ref from `remaining` and prints it as the set that removes the link, so a ref declared twice yields `set depends_on ["x"]` which leaves one copy behind; redundant-link guards this case explicitly (refs.count(ref) > 1 at :2188) while settled-link does not, so the two findings disagree about a duplicated declaration.

non-blocking: the `parsed.slug not in adjacency.get(slug, set())` guard cannot be false for a candidate that reached this line, because adjacency carries every non-terminal plan's depends_on edge to an open target, including this one, so it reads as a safety check that never fires and hides which condition actually excludes a candidate.

justifications.durability: the seven cases fail on the base revision (logs/armed-base.log: 4 failed) and the declared negative control reddens only the open-section control case (logs/negative-control.log: 1 failed, EXIT=1), so each guard names a code change that would redden it, including the open_waits guard the control removes.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's measure is genuinely asserted and its arms are logged with revision, tree and command, but the manifest's baseline_suite field does not parse and the fragment's ruff claim has no recorded log, so the record is strong rather than complete.
justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the surrounding _finding/extra idiom of reckon/roadmap.py:1630 and are named by what they measure, with no plan label, version or attribution in any symbol, test name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/roadmap.py:1972 and :2138 emit the two codes at severity info, each naming the ref and the subscribing set op (asserted at tests/test_a_link_that_orders_nothing_is_named.py:99 and :116), and the set forms they name are accepted by the store (reckon/_store.py:2597 for depends_on/after, reckon/_store_section_ops.py:452 for section_depends_on.<sid>).
justifications.reuse: the additions build on the existing owners — parse_plan_ref (reckon/_schema.py:289), _plan_section_deps (reckon/roadmap.py:446), open_sections (reckon/_plan_html.py:1051), _section_satisfied and _finding — and a search for an existing reachability or redundancy mechanism found only _dependency_cycles (reckon/roadmap.py:2391), which detects cycles rather than implying paths, so _reachable_avoiding extends the module rather than forking an owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --numstat 107f292bc 229f3fcde is inside the four declared write paths, and nothing the goal does not imply was changed.
